name: SLURP real
relevance: Human assistant requests with song/artist entities and some volume commands; strongest immediately usable domain match.
terms: Audio CC BY-NC 4.0; annotations CC BY 4.0.
status: Fresh pinned annotations; existing public audio copied into STT and trained. One fresh audio shard also completed after manifest freeze.

name: SLURP synthetic
relevance: TTS counterpart of assistant requests; possible augmentation, unsuitable as a human acceptance test.
terms: See publisher terms for the synthetic release.

name: Snips/Sonos SmartSpeaker
relevance: Music and volume text labels; human audio only for the test set. English/French artist requests use a Spotify popularity list. Particularly useful external music benchmark.
status: Reviewed; audio not obtained. No access form submitted.

name: Snips/Sonos SmartLights
relevance: Human brightness/color requests; spoken percentages transfer to numeric recognition, but lighting is not volume.
terms: Publisher research-only terms; mirror metadata is not a replacement license.
status: Existing close-microphone public audio copied and trained.

name: Fluent Speech Commands
relevance: 30,043 utterances, 97 speakers, 31 intents. Useful playback/relative-volume command wording; lacks unrestricted song titles.
status: Existing selected public audio copied and trained; inherited repeated rows removed.

name: Meta fair-speech
relevance: 26,471 assistant utterances from 593 speakers across seven domains including music; useful demographic evaluation.
terms: Publisher evaluation/use terms must be followed.
status: Reviewed; not acquired or mixed into training.

name: Speech-MASSIVE
relevance: Human speech plus assistant intents/slots in 12 languages; the listed languages do not include English. Relevant to future multilingual work.

name: MASSIVE
relevance: More than one million multilingual text utterances with intents/slots; useful grammar and entity examples, not acoustic training speech. Derived from SLURP.

name: Snips NLU benchmark
relevance: Text intents including PlayMusic and song/artist slots; useful parser vocabulary. Do not confuse it with human SmartSpeaker recordings.

name: Audio-Snips / AWS noisy SLU
relevance: SNIPS utterances synthesized with Amazon Polly voices; useful controlled augmentation, not independent human speech.
terms: Repository lists CC0; verify the specific audio release terms.

name: Free Spoken Digit Dataset (FSDD)
relevance: 3,000 human isolated digits, six speakers, 8 kHz. Small, direct 0–9 baseline; cannot establish 10–100 accuracy.
status: Full pinned archive freshly downloaded; all 3,000 recordings used with held-out speakers.

name: Google Speech Commands v2
relevance: Human isolated keyword classification, 35 words including zero–nine. No tens/hundred coverage.
status: Archive acquisition queued/attempted; no completed archive used. Existing root keyword data deliberately not counted as a fresh pull.

name: Multilingual Spoken Words Corpus (MSWC)
relevance: 23.4 million word examples across 50 languages; aligned Common Voice crops. Useful numeric words and media vocabulary, but word crops lose natural coarticulation.
status: Fresh split metadata plus 5,000 completed selected English clips. Frozen numeric run uses 900 eight/hundred clips.

name: MLEnd Spoken Numerals
relevance: Over 32,000 human numeral recordings with varied speakers/intonations. Selected 29 elementary values cover zero–nineteen, tens, and hundred.
terms: Publisher promotes ML use; explicit speech-data license not located in the pinned GitHub snapshot. Python package MIT is not a speech-data license.
status: Fresh 1,711 selected WAVs. Two identical files carrying conflicting numeric labels quarantined from evaluation.

name: SpokeN-100
relevance: 12,800 artificial numeral recordings from 32 voices/four languages, numbers 0–99. Does not include 100 or independent human voices.
status: Fresh README only; audio not downloaded or used.

name: Sheffield Numbers Corpus (SNuC)
relevance: Human connected alphanumeric sequences, over 13,000 recordings/about 20 hours. Useful sequence decoding; not balanced volume percentages.
status: Reviewed; approximately 9.8 GB release not acquired.

name: TIDIGITS
relevance: Human connected digits from adults/children; useful sequential digit models. Digit strings are different from English cardinal quantities.

name: CSLU Numbers
relevance: Telephone numbers, cardinal/ordinal quantities and digit strings. Useful numeric variation with telephone channel mismatch.

name: Common Voice Single Word
relevance: Human short words including digits; useful accent variation but insufficient tens/compound-number coverage.
terms: CC0 release; current distribution access conditions apply.

name: Spiking Heidelberg Digits (SHD)
relevance: Spoken English/German digits represented for spiking-network tasks. Limited to digits, not 0–100 cardinals.
status: Reviewed; not selected for this waveform CTC experiment.

name: LibriSpeech
relevance: Approximately 1,000 hours of human English audiobook speech; useful broad acoustic/word training, less representative of music commands.
status: Existing selected audio copied; 1,266 recordings pass the duration filter and are used.

name: Mini LibriSpeech
relevance: Small LibriSpeech subset for fast experiments; overlaps its parent corpus and must not be treated as independent evidence.
terms: Same source family; see release page.

name: Multilingual LibriSpeech (MLS)
relevance: Large multilingual audiobook speech, including English. Useful for larger scratch acoustic training; substantial storage/compute.

name: Mozilla Common Voice
relevance: Crowdsourced human read speech with accent variation. Shares parent data with MSWC; cross-corpus overlap needs checking.
terms: CC0 releases; current distribution account/access conditions apply.
status: Reviewed; no new account or gated download.

name: GigaSpeech
relevance: 10,000-hour English corpus with smaller subsets; broader vocabulary and proper names, domain mismatch remains.

name: The People's Speech
relevance: Large English transcribed speech collection; useful scaling candidate. Alignment quality and source-specific terms require filtering.
terms: CC BY / CC BY-SA components; check selected subset.

name: SPGISpeech
relevance: 5,000 hours of transcribed financial speech; useful numeric normalization and names but different from home commands.
status: Reviewed; not obtained and no contact information submitted.

name: FLEURS
relevance: Multilingual human read-speech benchmark, including English and Filipino. Filipino-language audio is not evidence for Philippine-accented English.

name: VoxPopuli
relevance: Large parliamentary speech collection with labeled/unlabeled portions; potential acoustic pretraining, substantial domain mismatch.

name: VCTK
relevance: Human English read speech from multiple accents/speakers. Useful pronunciation and speaker variation, not song requests.

name: LJ Speech
relevance: 13,100 clips from one reader. Public-domain speech for pipeline checks; weak evidence for unseen-speaker command recognition.
terms: Public domain as described by publisher.

name: TED-LIUM
relevance: Human English talks with broad vocabulary/proper names. Useful ASR training, weak match for short commands.
terms: CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 as listed for this release.

name: MUSAN
relevance: Music, speech and noise useful for augmentation/negative examples; does not provide the required command transcripts.

name: MLEnd Hums and Whistles
relevance: Hum/whistle recordings of a small song set; useful for melody identification, a different task from recognizing spoken song names.

name: MusicBrainz metadata
relevance: Song/artist names can supply a hypothetical dynamic vocabulary. Metadata supplies no pronunciation training audio and no Spotify account integration.
terms: Core metadata CC0; supplementary data CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.
status: Reviewed only; catalog fixtures here use SLURP entities.
